items.title: Progress on provable inference for large language models
items.summary: Anthropic describes FlashProve, an open-source prototype using zkSNARK proofs so users can verify a response came from a committed model. On Llama 4 Maverick with one H100 it produces proofs at about 110 tokens per second, at 70 to 95 times the GPU time of plain inference.
items.why: Primary lab research on verifying AI outputs, with concrete cost numbers.
